title: Mega Man 7
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man 7 starts with four selectable Robot Masters. The second four open after the museum intermission. You have a slide, charged Buster and Rush Coil.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.
Collect RUSH letters for Super Adapter. Its short second jump and homing punch help with later pickups, but it cannot slide. Many upgrades can also be built at Auto’s shop using bolts.
routeIntro: Cloud → Junk → Freeze → Burst follows the first weakness loop. Revisit Cloud and Junk with Freeze Cracker for their letters, then follow the second loop.

stages.name: Cloud Man
stages.tip: Use charged Buster shots, jump the lightning and move away from the wind push.

items.name: U letter
items.text: Return with Freeze Cracker. Freeze the second weather machine so snow reveals the hidden platforms, climb the later ladder, then jump left from the 1-Up ledge.

items.name: Super Adapter
items.text: Collect all four RUSH letters. Equip the combined adapter for a midair boost and homing punch; switch back to ordinary Mega Man to slide.
items.need: R, U, S and H letters
items.when: After the Cloud and Junk letter returns

stages.name: Junk Man
stages.tip: Use Thunder Bolt when he opens his defense. Avoid the suspended junk before it falls.

items.name: S letter
items.text: Freeze the pouring lava with Freeze Cracker and enter the passage it reveals.

items.name: Rush Jet
items.text: Electrify the machinery beneath the red AC sign. Use the activated lifts or Rush Coil to reach the ladder and item.

sprite.name: JunkMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Freeze Man
stages.tip: Bring Junk Shield close during an opening. Avoid the falling icicles.
stages.now: H letter · Rush Search · Escape Unit

items.name: H letter
items.text: Use Rush Coil to reach the high ladder and climb to the letter.

items.name: Rush Search
items.text: Cross the small ice platforms to the visible item. Return with Jet if the jumps are difficult.

items.name: Escape Unit
items.text: After getting Rush Search, dig a few blocks left of the boss gate.

sprite.name: FreezeMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Burst Man
stages.tip: Break trapping bubbles promptly and keep away from the ceiling spikes.

items.name: R letter
items.text: Collect the visible letter in the later bubble section. Watch the water height before jumping.

sprite.name: BurstMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Slash Man
stages.tip: Use Freeze Cracker and avoid the falling red gel. Do not get trapped in a corner.

items.name: Beat
items.text: Return with Scorch Wheel and burn the trees near the end. Climb the revealed ladder and shoot the cage.
items.extra: Beat rescues you from pits while rescue uses remain; he is not the attacking Beat from Mega Man 5.

sprite.name: SlashMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Spring Man
stages.tip: Strike when he comes down into reach; leave room for his long spring jumps.

items.name: Hyper Bolt
items.text: In the spring-box room, rotate the arrow box to point left and wait for its fist to break the gate. Take the bolt to Auto.

sprite.name: SpringMan
sprite.credit: Sprite hosted by MMHP; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Shade Man
stages.tip: Use charged Wild Coil, then dodge the swoop and sound waves.

items.name: Energy Balancer
items.text: Destroy the pumpkin miniboss by attacking its outer eyes to open the right route. Use Rush Search beneath the Wily portrait.

items.name: Proto Shield
items.text: First speak to Proto Man in Cloud’s high room: use Rush Coil to reach the ladder above a Sniper Joe near the late outdoor section. In Turbo’s traffic-light shaft, jump right through the false wall near the higher tire-throwing robot. Return to Shade, destroy the pumpkin’s inner core, descend and defeat the Sniper Joe. Walk right through the wall instead of taking the ladder. Defeat Proto Man for the shield.
items.need: Both earlier Proto Man encounters + Rush Coil
items.extra: Original passwords do not retain the two conversations. Use the collection save feature or finish all three encounters in the same session.

stages.name: Turbo Man
stages.tip: Bounce Noise Crush off a wall to empower it before firing. Jump over the car rush.

items.name: Rocket Buster upgrade
items.text: Use Rush Search on the first stoplight platform in the tall ladder shaft. This improves Super Adapter’s punch.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Clear all Robot Masters, check the utility items listed above, and refill the weapons needed for the final stages.

sections.title: Proto Shield and shop choices
paragraphs: Proto Shield blocks suitable projectiles coming from the front while you stand still. It is optional. The three encounters are shown together in Shade Man’s pickup card and return disclosure.
Bring the Hyper Bolt to Auto to unlock his improved shop. Buy supplies and useful upgrades before Wily; items already found do not need to be bought again.

sections.title: Wily’s fortress
paragraphs: Use Thunder Bolt on Bass’s first fight, then Super Adapter or charged Buster on the merged Bass/Treble form. Super Adapter is useful on the reachable fortress targets.
Against the turtle, strike the head with Wild Coil. Slash Claw works against the Guts-themed boss; shoot the blue cockpit of HannyaNED² with charged Buster or Slash Claw.
Wily Machine: use Thunder Bolt. Final Capsule: charge Wild Coil and control its bounce height to reach Wily. His elemental orbs are dangerous; bring several E-Tanks and a reserve weapon refill.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Switch out of Super Adapter before a slide tunnel. Rush Search takes time; activate it from the stated position rather than anywhere in the room.
Freeze Cracker changes stage hazards, not just bosses. Snow makes Cloud’s hidden route easier to see.
